subject: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold

Team — quick escalation. AstraNova (prospect in biotech) is asking for: 20% upfront discount, net-60 payment terms, and a clause limiting export controls liability (they want us to accept broad indemnity). Deal is our Q3 expansion opportunity (HubSpot DN-4821).

Why this is flagged: their legal/ownership is a bit complex — attached is an org chart they provided. Preliminary sanctions screen (attached CSV) flagged one beneficial owner with a low-confidence match to an entity in a jurisdiction on our watchlist. Procurement is pushing to close by EOW.

Ask: I need an executive-level decision on two fronts: 1) Approve a one-time commercial exception (discount up to 20%) and net-60 for closing incentive, OR approve a smaller concession and allow us to proceed with a conditional agreement; 2) Confirm whether we can accept the proposed non-standard export clause or insist on our standard export-controls language and KYC/EDD before signature.

If we must run enhanced due diligence (EDD), we need to inform the buyer now — that will push close by at least one week. Attached: SOW v3, org chart, sanctions export.

Short summary of risks/countermeasures I propose: 1) Offer 12% discount (instead of 20%) conditional on completion of KYC and no adverse matches; 2) Block non-standard export indemnity — instead add a narrow carveout for standard compliance; 3) If beneficial owner match persists, require escrow or restricted data residency plus a 6-month pilot with limited data access.

Please advise urgently — Procurement is threatening to escalate to their CFO tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold

Karthik — thanks for the summary and attachments. I concur with conservative approach. Two quick asks for the paperwork:

- Can you push Procurement for the full legal entity names, UBO info, and AML questionnaire answers (we need completed KYC forms from them today if possible)?
- Please mark this as "Priority: Deal Desk review" in HubSpot and add your recommended commercial concession (exact % and duration) — I'll present to pricing committee at 2pm PT today.

I support a conditional 12% discount with KYC and standard export-controls language. If legal flags the owner match, we should not sign anything until EDD completes.

Laura
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold

Team — reviewed attachments. Legal concerns: the org chart suggests beneficial owners with ties to an entity registered in Jurisdikstan (low-confidence match flagged by sanctions vendor). That region is not under a blanket embargo, but it is a watchlist country and increases regulatory risk.

My recommendations (legal):
1) Do NOT accept their proposed broad export indemnity. We have to retain our standard export-controls clause.
2) Require completion of Redwood EDD checklist before counter-signature: proof of identity for UBOs, recent AML questionnaire, and a certified copy of corporate registration.
3) Conditional approval path: If EDD clears and sanctions vendor returns no confirmed match, Legal will sign off and Deal Desk can approve up to 12% discount. If the match remains plausible, escalate to Executive Compliance (Aditya) and Finance for consideration of escrow or payment in advance.

If Procurement cannot produce the EDD materials by EOD Monday, we should pause negotiations.

— Vivek
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@astranova.bio>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@astranova.bio>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold

Elena — thanks for the call Friday. Per legal and Deal Desk guidance, to proceed we need the following by EOD Monday:
1) Completed KYC packet (UBO disclosure + AML questionnaire)
2) Corporate registration certificate for the buying entity
3) Confirmation of the primary data residency requirement (if any)

We can offer a conditional commercial concession of 12% (one-time, invoice credit) and standard Net-30 on signature — or Net-60 if you provide an irrevocable payment schedule. We cannot accept the indemnity language you proposed; we will provide our standard export-controls provisions.

If any of the KYC items are delayed, we will need executive compliance review which will push close by at least one week. Please send the documents to procurement@astranova.bio (copy me) and I'll escalate internally if we have missing items after your submission.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec sign-off for AstraNova terms / export & KYC hold

Team — reviewed thread and attachments. I approve a commercial concession of up to 12% one-time credit, conditional on: (1) completion of KYC/EDD with no confirmed adverse sanctions matches, (2) acceptance of Redwood's standard export-controls clause, and (3) payment terms limited to Net-45 (not Net-60) unless Finance signs off on credit exposure.

If Legal (Vivek) gets a confirmed match on the beneficial owner, do not proceed without explicit written approval from me and Finance (I will be looped). Also: hold any production access until Data Security signs off on environment restrictions.

Aditya
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
